errors.text_span: Хоризонталната ос показва списък от държави... Вертикалната ос, която представлява процента
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly swaps the horizontal and vertical axes. The horizontal axis shows the percentage values (from 0 to 25), and the vertical axis lists the countries.

The countries on the vertical axis are not sorted alphabetically. They are sorted in descending order based on their corresponding values, from Netherlands (21.2) at the top to Ireland (4.6) at the bottom.
The list of countries provided is incomplete. It omits several countries shown in the chart, including Малта (Malta), Румъния (Romania), Германия (Germany), Швеция (Sweden), and Дания (Denmark).
The value axis has major labeled tick marks at intervals of 5 (0, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25), not at intervals of 1.

errors.text_span: Стойността на най-ниския стълб е 4,6 (Обединено кралство)
errors.evidence: The lowest value of 4.6 corresponds to 'Ирландия' (Ireland), not 'Обединено кралство' (United Kingdom), which has a value of 5.8.
For a horizontal bar chart, the length of the bars corresponds to the value (percentage), not their width. The bars all have the same width (height in this orientation).
The description fails to mention that the bars are colored in two different colors, red and blue, which is a prominent feature of the chart.
